verdict.rationale: The product site gives only glancing first-time instructions: insert the key into any USB port with no software or drivers needed, then touch the capacitive sensor when prompted. Nothing shows a setup app or a step-by-step walkthrough for registering the key with accounts. Missing for 10: a dedicated setup app or guided enrollment wizard, step-by-step documentation for registering with specific services, PIN-setup guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that setup is easy.
